title: A Borel Concept Class of VC Dimension One with a Non-PAC Consistent Learner in ZFC
abstract: arXiv:2608.30246v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: The fundamental theorem of statistical learning states that, under suitable measurability assumptions, finite Vapnik--Chervonenkis (VC) dimension guarantees that every proper consistent learning rule is probably approximately correct (PAC). Blumer, Ehrenfeucht, Haussler, and Warmuth showed, assuming the Continuum Hypothesis, that the "well-behavedness" condition of the concept class cannot be omitted: they constructed a concept class of Borel sets of VC dimension one admitting a consistent learning rule that is not PAC. We show that the Continuum Hypothesis is unnecessary. Working in Zermelo--Fraenkel set theory with the Axiom of Choice (ZFC) alone, we construct a concept class of Borel sets on $[0,1]$ of VC dimension one and a proper consistent learning rule that is not PAC. translated_title: ZFC中一个VC维为一的Borel概念类及其非PAC一致学习器
translated_abstract: 统计学习基本定理指出，在适当的可测性假设下，有限的Vapnik--Chervonenkis（VC）维保证每个正常一致学习规则都是概率近似正确（PAC）的。Blumer、Ehrenfeucht、Haussler和Warmuth曾在连续统假设下证明，概念类的“良行为”条件不可省略：他们构造了一个VC维为一的Borel集概念类，该类容许一个非PAC的一致学习规则。我们证明连续统假设是不必要的。仅在带选择公理的Zermelo--Fraenkel集合论（ZFC）中，我们构造了[0,1]上一个VC维为一的Borel集概念类以及一个非PAC的正常一致学习规则。更精确地说，对于合适的Borel概率测度和目标概念，该规则在每个样本量下，其真实风险在一外概率为……的样本集合上等于1（摘要在此处截断）。
tldr: 本文证明无需连续统假设，仅在ZFC公理体系下即可构造出VC维为一的Borel概念类及其非PAC的一致学习器，从而表明统计学习基本定理中的可测性条件不可省略。
en_tdlr: Working in ZFC alone without the Continuum Hypothesis, the authors construct a Borel concept class of VC dimension one on [0,1] together with a proper consistent learning rule that is not PAC, showing that the measurability condition in the fundamental theorem of statistical learning cannot be dropped.
